title: One AI Conversation Can Use 500 Milliliters Of Water
hook: One AI conversation can consume a bottle's worth of water.
closing: Digital convenience still draws on a physical resource everyone shares.
question: Would water use change your habits?

segments.say: Microsoft's water use reached 6.4 million cubic meters. AI infrastructure has a physical footprint.
Google used 21.2 million cubic meters. The AI race draws heavily on local water supplies.
One AI conversation uses an estimated 500 milliliters. Small interactions add up at scale.
